moisture_pct.quote: Benkerroum and Tamime (2004) reported that the mean chemical composition of Jben was as follows: 62.5% moisture, 16.5% fat, 15.8% crude protein, 4.1% lactose, 1.04% titratable acidity, and pH 4.1.

ph.quote: Benkerroum and Tamime (2004) reported that the mean chemical composition of Jben was as follows: 62.5% moisture, 16.5% fat, 15.8% crude protein, 4.1% lactose, 1.04% titratable acidity, and pH 4.1.

compounds.quote: The acetoin content of unsalted Jben (19.51 mg/kg) was twice that of the salted one (8.56 mg/kg).
compounds.name: acetoin

ammonia.reason: No ripening proteolysis/deamination in fresh pH 4.1 curd, no ammonia accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw-milk flora without p-cresol/indole accumulation in fresh unripened curd.

bitter.reason: No aged proteolysis to hydrophobic bitter peptides despite lamb/vegetable rennet use.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; only ketone is acetoin, no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone.

browning.reason: High 62.5% moisture and low free amino acids limit Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Acetoin 8.56-19.51 mg/kg from LAB citrate metabolism, diacetyl not detected.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic/hexanoic/isopentanoic acids from minimal lipolysis in fresh curd.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 62.5% with 16.5% fat in acid gel gives lubricating spoonable creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Low-pH acid-precipitated demineralized casein fractures short, fresh drained curd.

firmness.reason: 62.5% moisture unpressed fresh acid gel with no rind gives very soft body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylethyl alcohol from LAB/yeast phenylalanine catabolism gives faint rose.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butyrate 4.09 mg/kg plus ethyl caproate/isoamyl acetate/hexyl acetate from LAB/yeast esterification.

goaty.reason: Mixed cow/goat/ewe milk but fresh, no concentrated branched goaty acids like 4-methyloctanoic.

malty_nutty.reason: No aging, no Strecker aldehydes or propionic-eyed nutty pyrazines in fresh cheese.

melt.reason: pH 4.1 calcium-depleted acid curd shrinks and wheys-off instead of flowing on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from lipoxygenase-mold pathway in fresh curd.

oil_off.reason: Only 16.5% fat entrapped in acid gel, no aged fat coalescence to oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make, no guaiacol/phenols from smoking process.

sour_vinegar.reason: pH 4.1, 1.04% titratable acidity from spontaneous lactic fermentation with acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata acid curd outside pH 5.2-5.4 calcium window for aligned stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Trace methionol from methionine catabolism, no cooked-curd H2S; curd uncooked.

sweet.reason: Residual 4.1% lactose gives milky sweetness balanced by high lactic acidity.

umami.reason: Minimal proteolysis and free glutamate without aging; fresh casein intact.
